title: 寫咗先望
subject: a shy man who sings the scholar's part in a Saturday amateur Cantonese-opera singing club in a To Kwa Wan community hall, paired for the annual show in a duet with the woman who joined in March, who only looks at her where the teacher has pencilled the word 'look' into his score, until on show night he opens it at the music stand and finds she has pencilled one beside every line
caption: Cantonese bachata in the modern romantic New York style. A bright requinto lead guitar playing rippling arpeggios and quick answering fills with a light chorus effect, a steel-string segunda guitar strumming syncopated chords, a round electric bass playing syncopated bachata lines, bongos in the martillo pattern through the verses with the player switching to bell in the chorus, and a steady güira scrape. Warm, clean, close-miked studio mix with the guitars upfront and little reverb. A tender male tenor with a light falsetto lift on the hook, intimate and smiling, softening his voice on the lines he quotes from her. 128 BPM, E major. Warm, playful, quietly in love. No reggaeton dembow, no trap beat, no EDM drums, no pop ballad strings, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
三月 禮拜六 兩點半
土瓜灣 社區會堂 二樓
你第一次開聲 唱子喉
頭架阿伯 即刻校高咗把高胡

[Pre-Chorus]
社長話 周年匯演 你做花旦
對住你唱嗰個小生 係我

[Chorus]
曲本上面 寫住三個望字
寫咗先望你 冇寫唔敢望
唔係唔想 係怕一望
就唔記得 下一句點唱

[Verse]
練咗成個月 我都望住譜架唱
啲情話 唱到個譜架都面紅
你話 「你係咪同個譜架 拍緊拖」
成班社員 笑到咳

[Pre-Chorus]
師傅嘆氣 攞起支鉛筆
喺我曲本 再加多兩個望

[Chorus]
曲本上面 多咗兩個望字
一共五個 喺邊頁我都記得
第五個一過 我又望返個譜
你喺隔籬 笑到走晒音

[Verse]
匯演嗰晚 會堂三百個位 坐滿晒
你着旗袍 我着長衫
我喺譜架度 揭開第一頁
每一句側邊 都多咗個望字

[Bridge]
鉛筆字細細粒 唔係師傅嘅
你尋晚話 借我本曲本執下
原來你 執咗成晚

[Chorus]
曲本上面 句句都有望字
由頭到尾 我冇低頭睇過譜
仲以為一望 就唔記得
原來望住你 一句都冇唱錯

[Outro]
落台你問 「冇寫嗰度 你仲望唔望」
我話 收埋本曲本 都照望
